title: China BRICS AI Masterplan: Xi Big Tech Move Sparks New Global Power Race
description: Chinese President Xi Jinping has unveiled a major artificial intelligence and smart manufacturing roadmap for BRICS nations, proposing an open-source AI ecosystem, digital technology cooperation and smart factory partnerships. The move comes as global powers compete for dominance in AI, semiconductors and critical mineral supply chains, while India warns against turning technology into a geopolitical weapon.
